authorship_is_blind: Both this document and the implementation it pins were written before the window-2 collection had started. SOLANA_RPC_URL was not set in the authoring environment, so the data was not merely unread but unreadable -- blindness by construction rather than by discipline.

burned_data_prior_NOT_A_RESULT.note: These are the figures the rule was derived from. They are a PRIOR against which the window-2 outcome is compared, and may never be quoted as an outcome of this study.
burned_data_prior_NOT_A_RESULT.why_the_rehearsal_differs_from_the_explo: The exploratory code assigned concentration 0.0 to 110 tokens with no net tokens bought, silently marking them SAFE; the runner excludes them as unreadable. Undefined is not zero. The runner is the correct implementation and its numbers supersede the exploratory ones.

primary_estimand.decision_map_is_in_code: classify() in the pinned runner makes the call. CONFIRMED requires lift >= 30pp AND passed-rate below the base rate; WEAKENED requires lift >= 10pp; otherwise FAILED. NOT_EVALUABLE if either arm is empty -- a refusal, not a null.
primary_estimand.quantity: unexitable rate among flagged tokens minus unexitable rate among passed tokens

purpose: Spend one evaluation pass on window 2 to test, out of sample, whether the deadness screen frozen on burned data separates unexitable tokens from exitable ones.

secondary_non_decisional.threshold_plateau: the passed-rate across thresholds 0.70-1.00 is reported for comparison with the burned-data plateau, and is DECLARED NON-DECISIONAL so that a threshold which happens to look better in window 2 cannot be promoted after the fact. The rule is 0.95 whatever that table says.

single_use.rule: one evaluation on window 2, recorded in the ledger. No second look, no re-run with an adjusted threshold, no promotion of a secondary. If the result is FAILED that is the finding.

the_cost_is_stated_in_advance.statement: The screen throws away roughly one in five tokens that WERE exitable. That cost is part of the finding and must be reported beside the benefit, never after it.

the_frozen_label.definition: a token is UNEXITABLE if the curve's real quote reserve never reached 50,000,000 lamports at any observation after t0+60 -- i.e. a 0.1 SOL position could not have recovered half its cost from money that was not its own
the_frozen_label.inherits_from: B19G's external-capacity principle: an exit funded by your own entry is not liquidity
the_frozen_label.name: external exitability
the_frozen_label.why_this_label: Two alternatives are broken on this venue and were rejected with measurements. An acute-collapse label is confounded by observation density: collapse rate runs 0.0% at 2-3 post-observations and 21.9% at 73+, because a collapse cannot be OBSERVED when there is nothing to observe it in. A fixed-horizon price label is worse: on a bonding curve the price only moves when someone trades, so a token nobody touches shows a flat price forever and reads as having HELD ITS VALUE while being worthless. Exitability treats 'never traded again' as unexitable, which is the correct answer.

the_frozen_rule.exact_arithmetic: top * 100 >= total * 95, integers only, no float comparison
the_frozen_rule.feature: share of all tokens bought in [t0, t0+60] held by the single largest buyer, computed by net position per wallet
the_frozen_rule.nothing_is_searched: K, the threshold and the label were all fixed on burned data before this document. No parameter is tuned against window 2.

the_runner_is_pinned.rule: Any edit after the collection begins breaks this pin and the study refuses. The pin is verified against the COMMITTED file, not the working tree -- the B19L lesson, where a frozen document pinned content that existed on one disk only.

what_is_not_claimed.edge: the screen creates no edge; it avoids a class of losses and nothing more
what_is_not_claimed.fraud: it predicts unexitability, not fraud or intent
what_is_not_claimed.rescue: nothing about the toll, the asymmetry or the negative-sum finding is changed by this screen. A screened population is not a profitable one.
